function.name: ETGO_GET_LOCATION
function.body:
v_c_location_id character varying; BEGIN -- ETP-5060: return the Location ID, NOT a pre-rendered address string. -- -- A computed column is raw SQL inside the query (Hibernate formula): it has no -- access to the request language, so any text it builds is frozen in the base -- language. That is why the country used to read "Spain" in a Spanish session: -- this function called ad_column_identifier_std, the variant WITHOUT a language -- parameter, and passing one in is not possible from here. -- -- Returning the id moves the rendering to read time: the column reference -- (Search -> Location) resolves the identifier through the DAL, which goes -- through C_Country_Trl and answers in the session language. An id is stable -- and language-independent, so materializing it freezes no translation. -- -- Zero rows (a partner with no active address) leaves v_c_location_id NULL: -- plain SELECT ... INTO assigns NULL and does not raise, unlike INTO STRICT. select bploc.c_location_id into v_c_location_id from c_bpartner_location bploc where bploc.c_bpartner_id = p_bpartner_id and bploc.isactive = 'Y' order by case when bploc.isbillto = 'Y' then 1 when bploc.isshipto = 'Y' then 2 else 3 end, bploc.created desc limit 1;
return v_c_location_id; END ETGO_GET_LOCATION
